title: Descend a given geometric curve and a source Weil diagram with local polynomial powers
statement: Let $k_0$ be finite, $\ell$ invertible in it, and $X$ affine of finite type over $k_0$. Let $G_1\hookrightarrow G_2\hookrightarrow G$ be monomorphisms of lisse source pro-etale Weil sheaves [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex; def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves]. Let $x,y$ be closed points. Put $\bar X=X\times_{k_0}\overline{k_0}$ [def-pc-base-change]. Suppose a closed immersion $v:D\hookrightarrow\bar X$ is given, with $D$ a smooth connected affine curve over $\overline{k_0}$, and that $v^*\operatorname{coker}(G_1\to G_2)$ is an irreducible geometric lisse sheaf (nonzero and no proper nonzero lisse subobject). Suppose geometric points $s_x,s_y$ of $D$ map to the canonical geometric lifts of $x,y$ used by the source local Frobenius construction [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace]. Then there exist a finite extension $k_1/k_0$, a smooth geometrically connected separated affine finite-type curve $C/k_1$, and lisse monomorphisms $H_1\hookrightarrow H_2\hookrightarrow H$ with irreducible lisse cokernel, and closed $s,t$ with positive $e,f$, such that $q_s=q_x^e$, $q_t=q_y^f$, and the characteristic polynomials of the cokernel Frobenii at $s,t$ equal those of $F_{x,\operatorname{coker}(G_1\to G_2)}^e$ and $F_{y,\operatorname{coker}(G_1\to G_2)}^f$. For every coefficient embedding $\iota$, reality [def-wf-iota-real] of $G$ implies reality of $H$. A morphism $c:C\to X$ satisfies $c(s)=x$, $c(t)=y$ and $c\gg p_X=p_C\gg\operatorname{Spec}(k_0\to k_1)$. No input or output eigenvalue is selected; no curve-existence or geometric-constituent assertion is made. Coincident points are allowed.

proof.text: Apply the explicit exact powered geometric pullback to the two monomorphisms and the ambient object. Exactness identifies its actual cokernel with the pulled-back cokernel. Pulling its carrier back along z identifies it with the input v* quotient. Reflection of geometric simplicity along z and geometric-to-arithmetic simplicity prove irreducibility. All objects and arrows are constructed and the combination is proved in Lean.

proof.text: Apply the single-object stalk comparison at both marked points to the original quotient. Transfer characteristic polynomials across the exact cokernel isomorphism. The model already supplies the structure square and marked images.

theorem exists_geometric_curve_diagram_descent
    {k₀ : Type u} [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime]
    [Fact (ringChar k₀ ≠ l)] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))] [IsAffine X]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀))]
    {G : WeilSheaf k₀ l X} (hG : G.IsLisse) {G₁ G₂ : WeilSheaf k₀ l X}
    (i : G₁ ⟶ G₂) (j : G₂ ⟶ G) [Mono i] [Mono j]
    (h₁ : G₁.IsLisse) (h₂ : G₂.IsLisse)
    (x y : X.finitePoints) (D : Scheme.{u})
    (v : D ⟶ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber)
    [IsClosedImmersion v] [IsAffine D]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
      (v ≫ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiberToAlgebraicClosure)]
    [ConnectedSpace D]
    (hgeo : ProEtale.IsIrreducibleAdicLocalSystem
      ((v)^*ᵃ[l].obj (cokernel i).obj.carrier))
    (sx sy : Spec (.of (AlgebraicClosure k₀)) ⟶ D)
    (hsx : sx ≫ v = (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiberPointOfFinitePoint x)
    (hsy : sy ≫ v = (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiberPointOfFinitePoint y) :
    ∃ (k₁ : Type u) (_ : Field k₁) (_ : Finite k₁) (_ : Algebra k₀ k₁)
      (_ : Fact (ringChar k₁ ≠ l)) (C : Scheme.{u})
      (_ : C.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁))) (_ : IsAffine C)
      (_ : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)))
      (_ : GeometricallyConnected (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)))
      (_ : IsSeparated (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)))
      (_ : LocallyOfFiniteType (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)))
      (_ : QuasiCompact (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)))
      (H H₁ H₂ : WeilSheaf k₁ l C) (a : H₁ ⟶ H₂) (b : H₂ ⟶ H)
      (_ : Mono a) (_ : Mono b),
      H.IsLisse ∧ H₁.IsLisse ∧ H₂.IsLisse ∧ (cokernel a).IsIrreducibleLisse ∧
      (∀ ι : PadicAlgCl l →+* ℂ, G.IsReal ι → H.IsReal ι) ∧
      ∃ (s t : C.finitePoints) (e f : ℕ), 0 < e ∧ 0 < f ∧
        (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)).residueCard s.1 =
          (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).residueCard x.1 ^ e ∧
        (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)).residueCard t.1 =
          (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).residueCard y.1 ^ f ∧
        ((cokernel a).stalk s).frobeniusEnd.charpoly =
          (((cokernel i).stalk x).frobeniusEnd ^ e).charpoly ∧
        ((cokernel a).stalk t).frobeniusEnd.charpoly =
          (((cokernel i).stalk y).frobeniusEnd ^ f).charpoly ∧
        ∃ c : C ⟶ X,
          c ≫ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)) =
            (C ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₁)) ≫
              Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k₀ k₁)) ∧
          c s.1 = x.1 ∧ c t.1 = y.1
